description: Booster boxes, booster packs, elite trainer boxes, tins, blisters and collections, by name, set, kind or language, each with its set, release date, the languages it physically exists in and its euro index. Covers the international, Japanese and Simplified Chinese lines: the Chinese line carries languages ["zh"]. 1 credit per 50 rows; a language filter scans pages of 100 (2 credits each) and keeps the matching rows. Quotes are a separate call, ptcg_get_sealed_prices, with the id returned here. If the result carries next_step, show its handoff sentence and URL to the user verbatim and do not retry.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call. Never construct one.

kind.description: Product kind as printed in the kind column: BOOSTER_BOX, BOOSTER_PACK, ETB, TIN, BLISTER, COLLECTION and others. Read the values off a search rather than guessing; an unknown kind returns no rows.

lang.description: Return product names in this locale, falling back to English.

language.description: Keep only products whose languages contains this ISO 639-1 code, e.g. "zh" for the Simplified Chinese line, "ja", "en". Scans pages of 100 at 2 credits each.

name.description: Product name or part of it, e.g. "evolving skies booster box", or an exact sku.

order_by.description: "-release_date" (default), "release_date", "name", "sku", "updated_at", "set", "-index_eur" or "-last_price_at". Every order ends on sku.

set.description: Set code, slug or alternate id, as returned by ptcg_list_sets.

name: ptcg_search_sealed
title: Search sealed products
